actual_path: The initial v43 mate verifier failed closed on its malformed default document path. A documented explicit-path override then completed a no-mutation read, but the emitted summary lacks the contract-required execution timestamp.
justification: The host observation cannot be admitted as verified current evidence until the corrected verifier emits the missing execution timestamp. Preserving the failed attempt, passed candidate, and re-run requirement prevents silent provenance repair.

affected_step_outcomes.reason: Candidate report is SHA-bound but has incomplete execution-time provenance.
Capture-to-release integration must not consume the unadmitted candidate.
